verdict.rationale: Vercel Sandbox is execution infrastructure for running agent-generated or untrusted code in isolated microVMs. A developer platform could plausibly offer built-in AI insights over its own usage or observability data, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no in-product AI-generated insights or suggestions. The closest items, such as running agent output and bundling coding agents in the default image, are developer building blocks rather than a first-party insights capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
